title.zh: 将设于甲米地省Carmona市镇的副区工程办公室升格为正式区工程办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Sub-District Engineering Office Located in the Municipality of Carmona, Province of Cavite into a Regular District Engineering Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the Sub-District Engineering Office Located in the Municipality of Carmona, Province of Cavite into a Regular District Engineering Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The sub-district engineering office located in the Municipality of Carmona, Province of Cavite, is hereby upgraded into a regular district engineering office to be known as the Cavite Third District Engineering Office.

The district engineering office shall serve the municipalities of Carmona, Silang and General Mariano Alvarez of the Fifth Legislative District of the Province of Cavite and the cities of Bacoor and Dasmariñas of the Second and Fourth Legislative Districts of the Province of Cavite, respectively.

The Secretary of Public Works and Highways shall include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Cavite Third District Engineering Office in the Province of Cavite, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
